headline: Tencent's hy4-flash holds the crown for day 2, now sitting on 42.3% of all tokens
summary: tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 is still refusing to give up the top spot, and its 42.3% share is an all-time record. Tencent as a provider holds 44.7% on its own, and Tencent plus DeepSeek together account for 68.2%.
highlights: tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 is rank 1 at 42.3% of tokens, an all-time record and day 2 of that streak.
Tencent holds 44.7% of tokens across its models, with DeepSeek second at 23.4%.
The top two providers, Tencent and DeepSeek, together hold 68.2% of tokens.
Five newcomers debut today, starting with openai/gpt-6.2-sol-20261117 at rank 42 and qwen/qwen4-max-20261115 at rank 46.
Dropouts include google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403 (last at rank 43) and x-ai/grok-4.7-20260916 (last at rank 47).
